articles.title: A Featherweight X-ray Telescope Could Unlock the Moon's Chemical Secrets
articles.summary: A compact telescope weighing under 10 kg might solve a decades-old lunar mystery. Simulations show it could map the entire Moon's surface chemistry in two years, revealing elements like oxygen and iron with unprecedented detail.

articles.title: How a Household Feather Duster Became a Surrogate Mom for Orphaned Turkey Chicks
articles.summary: Two orphaned turkey poults found an unlikely mother figure: a feather duster. Staff at a Pennsylvania wildlife rehab center used the common cleaning tool to mimic a hen's warmth and protection, calming the stressed chicks.

articles.title: Repeating Stellar Flashes Could Reveal Elusive Supermassive Black Hole Duos
articles.summary: Astronomers propose a new way to find tightly orbiting supermassive black hole pairs: look for repeating bright flashes caused by their combined gravitational lensing. The method could uncover hidden binaries years before gravitational wave detectors.
